title: Garden and Summer
author: Vesper Blackwood
blurb: Gideon Hartwell, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
